behavior: Uses one Host timer and serial transaction callback, coalesces recomputations and clamps long timer delays. Failed due members do not automatically spin; successfully committed batch members retain their own next obligation.
Recurring tasks with the same existing-session target share one message. Session flush must acknowledge before receipts advance; partial commit failure releases only uncommitted execution slots.

Reused destinations hold task slots until whole-Agent idle, including restored queued inbox messages. Occurrence- or acknowledgement-based delivery floors prevent overlapping timed/manual delivery without accumulating avoidable latency drift.

New-per-delivery targets persist a reservation before Session creation and reuse it on failed-delivery retry. Create-once targets become existing-session targets only on acknowledged delivery. Archive checks precede activation, Workspace/title failures are contained, and manual delivery preserves the scheduled occurrence and status.
Teardown stops admission/timers and drains the accepted drive transaction before its storage owner may close. Context services and the schedule/resolve-agent waterfall own activation and creation.

limitations: Controlled Agent/provider observations do not establish full live Agent, persistence-controller, Remote/tool or official application composition acceptance; service integration is next.
All possible async interleavings, synchronous RRULE worker responsiveness and extended-year receipt timestamp edge cases are not certified by this finite scope.
No complete regression, Portable/browser/Win7 acceptance or upstream promotion.
